prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years designing and shipping full-stack applications and AI-enhanced agent workflows. Built production-grade platforms on Cloudflare Workers, React, and Python, integrating LLM APIs, RAG, and AI evaluation pipelines. Delivered customer-focused solutions through CRM modules and integration blueprints for enterprise onboarding. Combined hands-on engineering and military-honed operational rigor for reliable delivery.

bullets.text: Built Job Fit Agent that ingested daily job postings via public APIs, performed RAG scoring with pgvector, and drafted tailored documents behind a human approval step.
Developed AI demo generator that transformed business URLs into shoppable 3D scroll demos in ~1 minute using Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2, D1, and a six-stage agent pipeline.
Engineered edge-based tycodes.dev platform with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind on Cloudflare Workers, using a Hono Worker to run Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audits and pricing models.

Built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python ICM pipeline that located local businesses via Google Places, audited sites, evaluated AI answers, and generated report cards with a Google Sheets CRM and draft-only outreach.
Architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that enabled rapid onboarding of enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, cutting manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed database-layer automated validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Mentored and onboarded new sales representatives, helping them achieve conversion rate benchmarks above 15%.
Secured over 50 qualified meetings per month, consistently exceeding quota.
